checks.name: anonymous local default and explicit cloud consent
two securely issued owners create distinct canonical creatures with identical names
cross-account reads, updates, simulator control and deletion fail closed
client owner claims, foreign origins, forged credentials and expired credentials are rejected
private conversation writes are idempotent and never leak across creatures
stale and simultaneous conditional writes cannot overwrite one another
explicit one-use device pairing restores only the issued private owner
actual Azure state survives a production server restart with the same credential
corrupt cloud checkpoint fails closed and explicit recovery advances its version
reset retains immutable genesis while deletion removes all private commit history
revocation invalidates all paired credentials and erases private data
